quest.title: Old Friends and New Knowledge
quest.description: Guided by the witch's dictionary, you head to Dragonspine to bring Albedo a brand-new assignment...
quest.rewards_formatted: Hero's Wit x3, Guide to Ballad x3, Mora x30000, Rhinedottir's "Gift" x1

chapter.title: Witch's Homework: Of Questions Beyond Questions

dialogues.text: Strange to see you so idle, Albedo.
But considering that you've completed Master Rhinedottir's final task, I suppose you deserve a break.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: See! What did Paimon tell you? You ask for trouble, and here it comes!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Sebas? What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait. You know this cat, Albedo?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Yes. He's also one of my master's creations. I suppose that makes him a... family member, of sorts.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ever the unconventional family you've got there.

dialogues.speaker: Sebas
dialogues.text: Hmph, don't you take that tone with me. I'll have you know that I alone keep that giant house in order as its butler.

dialogues.speaker: Sebas
dialogues.text: And yes, that has meant dealing with the assorted collection of vials and jars that you and Master use, washing them, drying them... All that work, done by one cat!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait. You're a butler? How does that work? How do you handle vials and stuff without... y'know, thumbs?

dialogues.speaker: Sebas
dialogues.text: How do you stay afloat in mid-air?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? It's just something Paimon's always known how to do.

dialogues.speaker: Sebas
dialogues.text: Housekeeping is the same for me. Such facts are not up for question, and shall receive no answers.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! You're not allowed to say the same answer that Paimon said, you—

choices.text: This cat belongs to Rhinedottir, Paimon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh. Sure, but don't expect Paimon to listen to his rambling...

response.speaker: Sebas
response.text: Allow me to get to the point, then. I'm here at Master Rhindottir's request. She has a message for me to pass along.

response.speaker: Sebas
response.text: Ahem!

response.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
response.text: "Dearest Albedo, in regard to that task I set for you, your discovery of an answer that you can accept is most delightful."

response.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
response.text: "Alas, once a problem is solved, mulling it over in one's head loses all meaning."

response.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
response.text: "I'm sure the pendulum in your ever-whirring mind is swinging toward 'boredom' as we speak."

response.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
response.text: "Might I suggest posing questions of your own, then?"

response.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
response.text: "Cast 'the answers you know' aside. Instead, embrace 'the questions you don't.'"

response.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
response.text: "After all, questions have always been more interesting than answers, and much better for passing the time."

response.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
response.text: "I look forward to what questions you'll bring me upon our next meeting."

response.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
response.text: "And should you come up with ones even I've never considered, all the better."

response.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
response.text: "It's unlikely, of course, but do your best. And who knows? If you're lucky, you might just surprise me."

response.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
response.text: "Oh, and don't attempt to create a 'self' whose sole purpose is to pose or ponder questions. I've tried it, and it doesn't work."

response.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
response.text: "Lastly, I sent Sebas with a gift for you. Do keep it well, alright? Ah, and no need to feed him. He doesn't get hungry."

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: As you instruct, Master.

response.speaker: Sebas
response.text: *coughing*... Master had quite a bit to say, I see... That really took a lot out of me, *coughing*...

response.speaker: Sebas
response.text: Well, I've passed the message along, so I shan't tarry in this frozen deathtrap for a second longer. I need to deliver a separate message to Mondstadt, at any rate...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Mondstadt?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, who else would have a connection to Rhinedottir in Mondstadt... Oh!

response.speaker: Sebas
response.text: Although his "birth" was rather recent, Master Rhinedottir has long foreseen what his "task" should be.

response.speaker: Sebas
response.text: But I digress. I shall be on my way. If I stay here a second longer, my tail might turn into an icicle.

response.speaker: Sebas
response.text: Your "gift" from Master Rhinedottir is on the table. Use it well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Y'know, Albedo... Your family gets more confusing by the second...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yeah, now you're even adding a cat to the mix...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of, would that cat really count as a family member? He called himself a butler and all, but...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Master created Sebas long before me. By the standards of a normal family, that would make him my "elder," I suppose.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Of course, my family could scarcely be considered "normal." So, by that logic, that type of relationship holds little meaning.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: At the same time, Sebas did look after me quite a bit back in the day, helping me tidy up various vials and jars... He even modeled for my sketches at times.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait a second, the cat you drew today... That's him then, isn't it?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Yes. Whenever I need to think, I turn to drawing, and let my subconscious take over. It always helps me sort my thoughts out.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: And, for some reason, I often wind up choosing a portrait of Sebas... I have drawn so many at this point that it's become second nature. Thus, this leaves my mind free to consider other things.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, we thought it was just a random cat! Guess he was a way bigger deal than we thought...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Well, now you know his real name. I can tell you more stories about him sometime, if you like.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: But right now...

response.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
response.text: "The tree takes pride in its most perfect fruit — so complete, so flawless."

response.speaker: "Rhinedottir"
response.text: "But you, O seed of dreams, do not settle for being the king of a universe confined to its flesh."

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: ...I need to think.

choices.text: We've seen you draw a cat before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Albedo! Thought we'd find you here. Oh! Are you painting?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Yes. I finally have a moment to myself, so I decided to pick up my brush and get some practice in.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, a lot of stuff has happened, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Indeed. Of course, thanks to your help, and my fellow Knights, that matter was resolved with little issue.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: In addition, I was able to complete the final task my master left for me.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I couldn't have asked for a better outcome.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Sucrose has been advancing swiftly in her studies, too. She can tackle many alchemy projects on her own now.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: The Knights of Favonius don't have any duties for me at the moment, either...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: No responsibilities, no tasks, no problems to resolve...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: It's not. It just feels strange, not having to wrack my brain for solutions to all manner of problems...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: To be quite honest, I'm finding the idle life a bit... hard to get used to.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I keep finding myself considering if there might be other issues that need solving.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: But, unfortunately for me, Mondstadt seems perfectly problem-free at the moment...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's nothing wrong with enjoying a bit of "me" time. Nothing good comes from working yourself to the bone.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But if you're really that bored, you can come hang out with us! Paimon will teach you the true art of doing nothing!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Haha, well, I suppose I should learn from the best.

choices.text: And if you're looking for trouble...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}! Don't say things like that! You're gonna jinx us!

choices.text: I have a knack for finding it...
You make that sound like a bad thing...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: New questions...

dialogues.text: Whoa! S—Sebas! Where did you come from? Paimon didn't hear a thing!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nice to see you again.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Oh, so you've met. I don't suppose Sebas told you of our relation to each other, did he...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He said he was your "elder."

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: ...If I had to put a label on it, then... I suppose that's fair.
